findings.violation: The delete control is a generic div containing an image with empty alt text. It has no button role, no accessible name, and is not properly exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Convert to a proper button element with an accessible name:

findings.evidence: Steps displayed as Confirm, Enter payment, Choose plan in visual order (order: 3, 2, 1) but appear in source order as 3, 2, 1 in reverse
findings.violation: CSS order property creates visual order that differs from DOM source order. Screen readers announce steps backwards from visual presentation, confusing users navigating with assistive technology.
findings.fix: Reorder the HTML source so source order matches visual order, removing the CSS order property: place step 1, then step 2, then step 3.

findings.violation: The label uses only color (red) to mark it as potentially required, but color alone is not a reliable indicator for users with color vision deficiency.
findings.fix: Add a text indicator of requirement, such as " (required)" in the label text or use an asterisk with a note elsewhere explaining what the asterisk means.

findings.location: Section 3 (Schedule changes), promo code field error (lines 67-68)
findings.violation: The input has aria-invalid="true" but no aria-describedby linking to the error message. The error message has no aria-live attribute, so screen reader users may not be notified of the error.
findings.fix: Connect the input to the error message with aria-describedby and add aria-live="polite" to the error message: Error.

findings.evidence: Local residents can check real time arrivals by calling rider services.
findings.violation: The status card is a generic div with no semantic role or landmark. Users with assistive technology cannot distinguish it from ordinary content flow.
findings.fix:
Add a role to clarify its purpose:

Local residents can check real time arrivals by calling rider services.

findings.violation: The table lacks a caption or accessible name to describe its purpose to screen reader users.
findings.fix: Add a caption to the table: <table id="s2-table1"><caption>Weekend service zone status</caption>...
